name: skafld-vc
description: Venture capital agents and skills across the deal lifecycle: sourcing against your thesis, screening, diligence, investment committee memos and portfolio reviews of founder updates, with returns, market sizing, unit economics, cap tables, valuation and term sheets, working from your documents. Scores against a research-based default rubric or your own, researches with Exa and Apollo when you add them, reads the data, CRM and notes tools you have connected, and writes HTML, Word, PDF, slide decks and Excel (with Node.js 18 or later), unbranded unless you set up your brand. No platform needed; firms with a SkaFld VC platform add SkaFld VC Platform.
